config.subject: We're sad to see you go
config.body:
Account

We're sad to see you go

Hi {{userName}},
Your {{siteName}} account has been permanently deleted and your personal data has been removed. Thank you for having been part of our community — it truly meant a lot to us.

You're always welcome back. If you ever change your mind, you can create a new account any time and pick up right where you left off.

If you didn't request this, or you think your account was deleted by mistake, please get in touch with us right away.

This message was sent to {{userEmail}}. Please do not reply to this automated email.
config.successMessage: Your account has been deleted. We're sad to see you go.

teleportProductFavourites.name: teleportProductFavourites
teleportProductFavourites.query: SELECT f.entity_id FROM teleport_favourites f INNER JOIN teleport_products p ON f.entity_id = p.id::text WHERE f.entity_type = 'teleport_products' AND f.user_id = '{{Current User.id}}' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
